notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41818539/488afad7d2c9ea811fa4cb3c910ba6848073e71c.jpg[/img]

Dear friends,

We're so excited and proud to announce that End of Lines, our next interactive graphic novel, is finally launching on May 25th! 😃

Please check out our brand-new trailer below.

[previewyoutube=I_FP8IPv9hs;full][/previewyoutube]

We can't wait to finally share the result of these last three years of work with you all!
Don't hesitate to spread the word and please add the game to your wishlist.

See you at launch!

Cheers,

Geoffroy,
on behalf of the team.
